S7 — DIAGRAM / SPECIFICATION PAGE 2/3 (Drawing 811850E00, Issue F)

This is page 2 of 3 of the component specification list (СПЕЦИФИКАЦИЯ) for KONE LCE elevator wiring drawing 811850E00, Issue F, dated 05.06.2002. Language: Russian (ru). Designed by J. Kantola, Checked by A. Jokivalli, Approved by P. Huotari. Department: ECC. Product code: LCE.

Revision history visible on this page:
- Issue F: Pos. 101, 176, 732:1 added — 08/06 — A. Zotti
- Issue E: Pos. 7, 71:SC, 94:B added — 07/06 — JKa
